facility_description: AlSat-1 was an Algerian microsatellite built using SSTL platform modules.
notes: Owner ASAL page was opened in the web tool, but later requests timed out. The WMO instrument registry opened at https://space.oscar.wmo.int/instruments/view/slim6 describes two side-by-side three-channel VNIR radiometers for land/disaster monitoring. Instrument description withheld pending access to owner specifications or original DMC manual; the existing ESA manual URL could not be retrieved. No redistribution grant or requested acknowledgement was located. SLIM6/Disaster Monitoring Constellation has commercial participants; do not infer public rights from public download availability.
